zh: 你问豆包一句话，背后就有一整条产业链开始运转。
en: Ask Doubao one question, and an entire industrial chain starts running.

zh: 工业时代，石油推动机器。
en: In the industrial age, oil powered machines.

zh: 互联网时代，流量推动了生意。
en: In the internet age, traffic powered business.

zh: 到了 AI 时代，最基础的一种消耗叫做 Token。
en: In the AI age, a basic unit of consumption is the token.

zh: 可这跟我们普通人又有什么关系？
en: But what does this have to do with ordinary people?

zh: 今天，就把 Token 背后这条链理清楚。
en: Today, let us map the chain behind tokens.

zh: 听完你再判断，自己能站在哪儿。
en: Then decide where you can stand in it.

zh: Token 到底是什么？
en: What exactly is a token?

zh: 它不是虚拟货币，也不是算力。
en: It is neither virtual currency nor computing power.

zh: 说简单点，它是大模型处理信息时的计量单位。
en: Simply put, it measures information processed by a large model.

zh: 你让豆包回复一段话。
en: You ask Doubao to reply with a paragraph.

zh: DeepSeek 写一份文案。
en: DeepSeek writes a piece of copy.

zh: Kimi 分析一份文件。
en: Kimi analyzes a document.

zh: 输入和输出，都会拆成 Token。
en: Both input and output are broken into tokens.

zh: 企业只要在用大模型、智能体或者 AI 应用。
en: Whenever a company uses models, agents, or AI applications,

zh: Token 和背后的算力就在持续消耗。
en: tokens and the computing power behind them are continuously consumed.

zh: 如果你只在聊天框里用 AI，很容易看不到这条产业链。
en: Using AI only in a chat box can hide the industrial chain behind it.

zh: 等它接入手机、电脑、企业系统和各种智能终端。
en: As AI enters phones, computers, business systems, and smart devices,

zh: 围绕 Token 的生意还会继续往外长。
en: the businesses around tokens will keep expanding.

zh: 先看上游：芯片、服务器、光模块。
en: Start upstream with chips, servers, and optical modules.

zh: 数据中心、电力、网络、冷却系统，共同构成大模型服务背后的基础建设。
en: Data centers, power, networks, and cooling form the infrastructure behind model services.

zh: 上游卖的就是这些东西和算力。
en: The upstream sells infrastructure and computing power.

zh: 再往中间走，就是大模型公司、云平台。
en: In the middle are large-model companies and cloud platforms.

zh: 还有智能体平台和 AI 开发工具。
en: They also include agent platforms and AI development tools.

zh: 它们把底层算力封装成企业可以直接调用的能力。
en: They package computing power into capabilities companies can call directly.

zh: 中游卖模型，也卖平台和服务。
en: The midstream sells models, platforms, and services.

zh: 链条最后一段，才是离普通人最近的下游。
en: The last link, downstream applications, is closest to ordinary people.

zh: 医疗、教育、制造、农业、内容、电商和本地服务。
en: Healthcare, education, manufacturing, agriculture, content, e-commerce, and local services.

zh: 只要把 AI 接进一项真实业务，都算下游应用。
en: Connecting AI to a real workflow creates a downstream application.

zh: 它不一定训练大模型，客户最后买的也不一定是模型。
en: It may not train a model, and a model is not necessarily what customers buy.

zh: 客户买的是一个有用的结果。
en: Customers buy a useful result.

zh: 上游卖算力，中游卖模型，下游卖结果。
en: Upstream sells compute, midstream sells models, downstream sells results.

zh: 还有“Token 出海”，这个词很容易听歪。
en: The phrase token export is also easy to misunderstand.

zh: 它不是把 Token 像石油一样装车运送。
en: It does not mean loading tokens onto trucks like oil.

zh: 而是把电力、服务器和数据中心变成算力。
en: It means turning power, servers, and data centers into computing services.

zh: 再通过网络，把算力和模型服务送出去。
en: Then delivering compute and model services through networks.

zh: 甘肃已经在这条链上。
en: Gansu is already on this chain.

zh: 国家已经批复甘肃建设全国一体化算力网络国家枢纽节点。
en: China approved Gansu as a national hub node of the integrated computing network.

zh: 庆阳正在建设数据中心集群。
en: Qingyang is building a data-center cluster.

zh: 目标之一是形成面向全国的算力保障能力。
en: One goal is to provide computing support for the country.

zh: 甘肃省中医院研发的“陇小郎”。
en: Longxiaolang was developed by Gansu Provincial Hospital of Traditional Chinese Medicine.

zh: 把中医舌诊经验和 AI 结合。
en: It combines AI with experience in traditional Chinese tongue diagnosis.

zh: 已经完成独家授权和首轮成果转化。
en: It has completed exclusive authorization and its first result transfer.

zh: 这就是一个发生在甘肃的行业应用。
en: This is an industry application happening in Gansu.

zh: 说到这里，普通人的位置就比较清楚了。
en: At this point, the position for ordinary people is clearer.

zh: 建数据中心需要资本，训练大模型需要技术团队。
en: Data centers need capital; training models needs a technical team.

zh: 对普通人和本地创业者来说，能进去的地方就是下游。
en: For ordinary people and local founders, downstream is the accessible layer.

zh: 你懂餐饮、制造、农业、销售、门店或财务。
en: You may know restaurants, manufacturing, agriculture, sales, retail, or finance.

zh: 哪怕只吃透一条具体的业务流程。
en: Even mastering one specific business workflow can be enough.

zh: 都有机会借助现成的模型和算力。
en: You can build on models and computing power that already exist.

zh: 把它做成 AI 应用、服务，或者一个能交付的系统。
en: Turn it into an AI application, a service, or a deliverable system.

zh: 这就是我留在兰州做企业 AI 的原因。
en: That is why I stayed in Lanzhou to work on enterprise AI.

zh: 我想把上游算力、中游模型，接到甘肃本地企业的业务里。
en: I want to connect upstream compute and midstream models to local Gansu businesses.

zh: 最后做成有人用、交得出去的应用。
en: The goal is an application people use and that can actually be delivered.

zh: 普通人想抓住 Token 红利。
en: If ordinary people want to seize the token opportunity,

zh: 别着急追名词，也别着急猜哪家公司会涨、上涨。
en: do not rush after buzzwords or guess which company will rise.

zh: 先把这条链看清楚，再决定自己站在哪里。
en: See the chain clearly first, then decide where you can stand.

zh: 关注我，我是超哥，在兰州记录 AI 创业。
en: Follow me. I am Chao, documenting AI entrepreneurship in Lanzhou.
